record_type_quote: This study conceptually replicated and extended Reid, Trofimovich, and O’Brien (2019), who found that native English speakers could be biased positively (or negatively) relative to a control condition in terms of how they rate non-native English speech.

targets.authors: Reid, K. T., Trofimovich, P., & O’Brien, M. G.
targets.title: Social attitudes and speech ratings: Effects of positive and negative bias on multiage listeners’ judgments of second language speech.
targets.evidence_quote: This study conceptually replicated and extended Reid, Trofimovich, and O’Brien (2019), who found that native English speakers could be biased positively (or negatively) relative to a control condition in terms of how they rate non-native English speech.
targets.outcome_quote: Our internet-based study failed to replicate Reid et al. across a wider population sample of “native” speakers (n = 189).
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall failure verdict in the abstract.

reasoning: Completed conceptual replication in a fresh online sample. Reid 2020 and 2021 and other speech-perception studies are background, not additional re-tested originals.
